subject: Re: Question regarding AgentKit setup and MCP tools
body:
Hi there,

Thank you for reaching out regarding AgentKit and our MCP server architecture. Yes! AgentKit supports secure, connection-pooled integrations with PostgreSQL as well as vector databases and SQLite ledgers, allowing your autonomous agents to execute queries and manage state safely.

Check out our documentation repo or let us know if you'd like a guided technical walkthrough.

Best regards,
AgentKit Engineering Team
